scanNote:
1-MODUL MUQOVASINING O'NG BETI. Bet raqami bosilmagan.

O'ng yuqorida katta yashil harflar bilan 'Module' va uning yonida to'q sariq yorliqda oq '1'. Ostida keng oraliqda yashil: 'U n i t s  1 - 4'. Bularning atrofida katta OCH SARIQ DOIRA.

Doira ichida ikkita to'q sariq uchburchak va ikkita ro'yxat:

'Learn how to ...' (qanday qilishni o'rganing):
• welcome people
• agree & disagree
• describe lost property
• ask about prices
• make polite requests & offers
• report events (as a witness)
• tell the time

'Practise ...' (mashq qiling):
• present simple/continuous
• adverbs of frequency
• past simple/used to/past continuous
• adjectives/adverbs/comparisons
• must/can't/will (certainty)

Chap tomonda:
• 3-UNIT: ko'k harflar bilan 'Shop till you Drop!'; ko'k oval ichida oq 'Unit 3'.
  SURATLAR: (1) supermarket rastalari orasida savat aravachasidagi chaqaloq bilan turgan ota va yonida ayol; (2) kechasi chiroqlar bilan yoritilgan HARRODS univermagi binosi.
  Ro'yxat (o'ngda, doira ostida): shops and shopping; objects & shapes
• 4-UNIT: yashil harflar bilan 'Days to Remember'; yashil oval ichida oq 'Unit 4'.
  SURAT: chizma rasm - daraxtga ilinib qolgan sariq havo shari savati va yonida yerdagi ikkinchi havo shari; savatdagi ayol va yonidagi erkak yuqoriga qaramoqda; daraxt savatida bola o'tiribdi.
  Ro'yxat: feelings and reactions

⚠ Modul rejasi IKKI QISMGA bo'lingan: 'Learn how to' (nutq vazifalari) va 'Practise' (grammatika).

exercises.instructionEn: Module 1 - Units 1-4. Learn how to ... Practise ... Unit 3: Shop till you Drop!  Unit 4: Days to Remember.
exercises.instructionUz: 1-modul - 1-4-unitlar. Qanday qilishni o'rganing... Mashq qiling... 3-unit: Charchaguningcha xarid qil!  4-unit: Esda qoladigan kunlar.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET - 1-MODUL MUQOVASINING O'NG
BETI: MODUL REJASI.

  ⚠ Bet raqami bosilmagan.


REJA IKKI QISMDAN:

  1) 'LEARN HOW TO ...'
     = ... qilishni o'rganing
     Bu - NUTQ VAZIFALARI
     (til bilan NIMA QILISh).

  2) 'PRACTISE ...'
     = ... ni mashq qiling
     Bu - GRAMMATIKA.

  ⚠ Ya'ni: avval nima uchun kerakligi,
  keyin qanday tuzilishi.


'LEARN HOW TO' RO'YXATI:

  welcome people
     = odamlarni kutib olish

  agree & disagree
     = rozi bo'lish va rozi bo'lmaslik

  describe lost property
     = yo'qolgan buyumni tasvirlash
     ⚠ 'lost property' = yo'qolgan
     buyumlar (temir yo'l vokzalidagi
     'Lost Property Office' - topilma
     buyumlar bo'limi).

  ask about prices
     = narx so'rash

  make polite requests & offers
     = xushmuomala iltimos va takliflar
     ⚠ 'a request' = iltimos
     ⚠ 'an offer' = taklif
     ⚠ 'polite' = xushmuomala

  report events (as a witness)
     = voqeani guvoh sifatida so'zlab berish
     ⚠ 'a witness' = guvoh

  tell the time
     = soatni aytish
     ⚠ DIQQAT: 'to tell the time' -
     'to say the time' EMAS. Bu
     turg'un ibora.


'PRACTISE' RO'YXATI:

  present simple / continuous
     = hozirgi oddiy / davomli zamon

  adverbs of frequency
     = takrorlanish ravishlari
     (always, usually, often, sometimes,
      never)

  past simple / used to /
  past continuous
     = o'tgan zamon shakllari
     ⚠ 'used to' = ilgari qilar edi
     (endi qilmaydi)

  adjectives / adverbs / comparisons
     = sifat / ravish / qiyoslash

  must / can't / will (certainty)
     = aniqlik bildirish
     ⚠ 24-25-betdagi hikoya aynan shu
     mavzuni mashq qildiradi.


UNIT 3 - 'Shop till you Drop!'

  So'zma-so'z: 'yiqilguningcha xarid qil!'
  = charchaguningcha xarid qil

  ⚠ 'till' = 'until' ning qisqa shakli
  = ... gacha
  ⚠ 'to drop' = yiqilmoq, tushib ketmoq

  Mavzular:
     • shops and shopping = do'konlar va xarid
     • objects & shapes = buyumlar va shakllar

  SURATLAR:
     1) SUPERMARKET - aravachada chaqaloq
        bilan turgan ota.
     2) HARRODS - Londondagi mashhur
        univermag, kechasi chiroqlar bilan.
        ⚠ 'a department store' = univermag.
        ⚠ 21-betda Harrods haqida matn bor.


UNIT 4 - 'Days to Remember'

  = Esda qoladigan kunlar

  ⚠ 'to remember' = eslamoq.
  ⚠ 'days to remember' - INFINITIV
  otdan keyin: 'eslash uchun kunlar',
  ya'ni 'unutilmas kunlar'.

  Mavzu:
     • feelings and reactions
       = his-tuyg'ular va munosabat

  SURAT: daraxtga ilinib qolgan HAVO
  ShARI savati.
     ⚠ 'a hot-air balloon' = havo shari.
     ⚠ Bu - kutilmagan voqea, ya'ni
     'a day to remember'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to welcome    = kutib olmoq
  to agree      = rozi bo'lmoq
  to disagree   = rozi bo'lmaslik
  lost property = yo'qolgan buyumlar
  a price       = narx
  polite        = xushmuomala
  a request     = iltimos
  an offer      = taklif
  to report     = xabar bermoq
  an event      = voqea
  a witness     = guvoh
  certainty     = aniqlik
  frequency     = takrorlanish, chastota
  a comparison  = qiyoslash
  a shape       = shakl
  an object     = buyum, narsa
  a department store = univermag
  a feeling     = his-tuyg'u
  a reaction    = munosabat, javob
  a hot-air balloon = havo shari
  till          = ... gacha
  to drop       = yiqilmoq

points.noteUz:
⚠ Kitobda 4 modul, jami 15 unit.
Birinchi uchta modulda 4 tadan, oxirgisida
3 ta unit bor.

points.en: Learn how to welcome people; agree & disagree
points.uz: Odamlarni kutib olishni; rozi bo'lish va rozi bo'lmaslikni o'rganing
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Learn how to ...' - NUTQ VAZIFALARI:
til bilan NIMA QILISh mumkinligi.

⚠ 'to agree' - predlogsiz: 'I agree with you'
(odam bilan), 'I agree to the plan' (rejaga).

points.en: Learn how to describe lost property; ask about prices
points.uz: Yo'qolgan buyumni tasvirlashni; narx so'rashni o'rganing
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'lost property' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot:
'property' hech qachon 'properties' bo'lmaydi
bu ma'noda.

⚠ Vokzallarda 'Lost Property Office' -
topilgan buyumlar bo'limi.

points.en: Learn how to make polite requests & offers
points.uz: Xushmuomala iltimos va takliflar qilishni o'rganing
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to make a request' - 'to do' EMAS.
Bu COLLOCATION (doimiy birikma).

⚠ 'a request' = iltimos; 'an offer' = taklif.

points.en: Learn how to report events (as a witness)
points.uz: Voqeani guvoh sifatida so'zlab berishni o'rganing
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a witness' = guvoh.
⚠ 'as a witness' = guvoh sifatida.

⚠ Bu 4-unitning muloqot mavzusi:
'witness' report'.

points.en: Learn how to tell the time
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to TELL the time' - 'to say the time'
EMAS! Bu turg'un ibora.

⚠ 'tell' bilan yana: tell a story, tell a lie,
tell the truth, tell the difference.

points.en: Practise present simple/continuous; adverbs of frequency
points.uz: Present simple/continuous; takrorlanish ravishlarini mashq qiling
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'adverbs of frequency' = always, usually,
often, sometimes, rarely, never.

⚠ 'frequency' = takrorlanish; 'frequent' =
tez-tez uchraydigan.

points.uz: Past simple/used to/past continuous ni mashq qiling
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'used to' = ILGARI qilar edi, endi qilmaydi:
'I used to play football.'

⚠ Undan keyin HAR DOIM oddiy infinitiv
(to'siz emas, 'to' bilan): used TO PLAY.

⚠ 'certainty' = aniqlik, ishonch.

⚠ 24-25-betdagi 'The Shark Caller' hikoyasi
aynan shu mavzuni mashq qildiradi.

points.en: Unit 3: Shop till you Drop! - shops and shopping; objects & shapes
points.uz: 3-unit: Charchaguningcha xarid qil! - do'konlar va xarid; buyumlar va shakllar
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'till' = 'until' ning qisqa shakli.
⚠ 'to drop' = yiqilmoq.

⚠ So'zma-so'z 'yiqilguningcha xarid qil' -
ya'ni juda ko'p xarid qilish.

points.en: The picture shows Harrods, a famous department store in London.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a department store' = univermag
(ko'p bo'limli katta do'kon).

⚠ 21-betda Harrods haqida o'qish matni bor.

points.en: Unit 4: Days to Remember - feelings and reactions
points.uz: 4-unit: Esda qoladigan kunlar - his-tuyg'ular va munosabat
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'days to remember' - otdan keyin INFINITIV:
'eslash uchun kunlar' = unutilmas kunlar.

⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'something to eat',
'a place to stay'.

points.en: The picture shows a hot-air balloon caught in a tree.
points.uz: Suratda daraxtga ilinib qolgan havo shari.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a hot-air balloon' = havo shari
(so'zma-so'z: issiq havo shari).

⚠ Kutilmagan voqea - aynan 'a day to remember'.

patterns.formula: In this module I learn how to [nima qilish].
patterns.exampleEn: In this module I learn how to welcome people.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu modulda odamlarni kutib olishni o'rganaman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'learn how to' + INFINITIV.
⚠ Betdagi 'Learn how to ...' qolipi.

⚠ Britaniyada fe'l 'practiSe', ot 'practiCe'.
⚠ AQShda ikkalasi ham 'practice'.
⚠ 'to teach' — noto'g'ri fe'l: teach - taught - taught.
